newsitem.title: SWEDEN: BALTICS-MERRILL LYNCH BULLISH ON BALTIC REGION.
newsitem.headline: BALTICS-MERRILL LYNCH BULLISH ON BALTIC REGION.

text.p: U.S. investment bank Merrill Lynch said on Thursday it was bullish on Baltic investment opportunities and plans to diversify its activities there.

"We have been very active in debt markets and are now looking at large privatisation and equity investments," Merrill's Marcin Wezyk told Reuters at a Euromoney conference on capital markets in the Baltic states.
Merrill has been especially active in Lithuania's local debt market, Wezyk said.
"We hold roughly $100 million in Lithuanian T-bills on average at any one time and we are often the biggest bidders at primary auctions," he said.
He added that T-bills in Latvia and Lithuania were still attractive despite a recent fall in yields.
Merrill also plans to underwrite more private placements and loans for Baltic companies, Wezeyk said, although he declined to say which firms.

In Lithuania, Merrill has been active underwriting in the enrgy sector. It underwrote a three-year, $125 million placement for Lithuanian Energy, $50 million of it a straight loan and $75 million in FRNs.
It has also underwritten smaller sums for refiner Mazheikiu Nafta and is working on a private placement for Lithuanian Gas, he said.
